classification: needs-adjudication; not counted as proven objective defect
reason: The consumer proves an existing inventory document is handed over. It does not independently prove whether using that document also constitutes issuing a summons. Czech vystavit can mean issue an administrative document; Russian выдать allows that sense. The evidence favors předat as the narrower physical action, but this alone is insufficient to require the rewrite. Retain this proposal only if the author/coordinator can substantiate the semantic discrepancy; otherwise dismiss it as equivalent valid wording.
